meaningfully_new: A source-supported fact, state transition, timing boundary or rule interaction not exercised by an accepted question. Rewording, player/color swaps, arithmetic changes and a different narrative with the same decision do not qualify. A boundary interaction qualifies only if a plausible different ruling would survive existing questions.
scope: Same 2014 core extraction; cached 2024 PDF is excluded. Unresolved source questions are logged as source limits, not fabricated answer targets.
process: Preserve original 20 and their key. Freeze each extension separately before new blind reader pairs. Grade all material facts, repair if needed, and retest affected and earlier sets on exact final bytes. Continue source-rule and boundary sweeps until subsequent viable candidates are duplicates; retain rejection reasons.
stopping_rule: All accepted questions pass both readers on exact final summary, final independent source audit covers identical bytes, source-rule ledger has no uncovered source-backed material fact, and two consecutive documented final candidate sweeps add no meaningful new source-backed question. This is bounded saturation relative to the selected source, not proof all possible situations are covered.
batch_sizes: Extension sizes follow meaningful novelty rather than padding to 20; this follows the user’s explicit expansion request.
